modmenu.descriptionTranslation.locator_l:
Waxay ku dartaa Lodestones Baarka Tilmaamaha Ciyaartoyga.

Compass-yada Lodestone ee ku jira Alaabtaada (oo ay ku jiraan Bundles) waxay ku daraan Waypoints Baarkaaga Tilmaamaha.
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_display.t: Haddii haynta badhanka tab ay ku qasbeyso baarka tilmaamuhu inuu muuqdo, loo baahan yahay si uu u muuqdo, ama wax saameyn ah lahayn (default)
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_shows_nam: Haddii haynta badhanka tab ay muujiso magacyada waypoint-yada compass-ka
configs.locator_lodestones.show_recovery: Haddii Compass-yada Soo-kabashadu sidoo kale abuuraan waypoints
configs.locator_lodestones.show_bundled_: Haddii compass-yada ku jira Bundle-yadu sidoo kale muuqdaan
configs.locator_lodestones.show_in_spect: Haddii waypoint-yada compass-ku weli ku muuqdaan Habka Daawadaha
configs.locator_lodestones.color_customi: Haddii midabka waypoint-yada lagu beddeli karo adigoo dhigaya hex code magaca shayga
configs.locator_lodestones.lodestone_col: Midabka default ee waypoint-yada Lodestone Compass. Waxaa loo dejin karaa 'random' si random ah
configs.locator_lodestones.recovery_colo: Midabka default ee waypoint-yada Recovery Compass. Waxaa loo dejin karaa 'random' si random ah
